facts.business: Shivalik Rasayan Limited is an integrated chemical manufacturer spanning agrochemicals and high-value active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), evolving from a legacy producer of technical-grade agrochemicals into a science-led chemical and life sciences enterprise with a CDMO focus.

auditor.name: AMJ & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Audit Committee meeting on August 13, 2024 attended by only one Independent Director; BSE and NSE issued warning letters dated October 14, 2025 for non-compliance with Regulation 18(2)(b) of SEBI LODR.

key_risks: Increase in raw material prices and higher manufacturing and operating expenses compressing margins
Regulatory compliance risk: Audit Committee quorum non-compliance leading to exchange warnings
Transition of R&D from cost center to profit center may not materialize as planned
Dependence on development of NCE-1 molecules and CDMO model for future growth
facts.related_party_note: Related parties include holding company Growel Remedies Limited, associate company Medicamen Biotech Limited, and key managerial personnel including Chairman Rahul Bishnoi, Vice Chairman Suresh Kumar Singh, Managing Director Vimal Kumar Shrawat, and other directors.
